product_overview: Sellora Frontend is a React-based web interface for the Sellora E-Commerce Intelligence platform. It provides a responsive, modern UI for users to access product and business intelligence insights through the application frontend.
core_goals: Deliver a fast, responsive frontend experience for Sellora users
Present e-commerce intelligence data clearly and accessibly
Provide a maintainable TypeScript-based UI built with React and Vite
Ensure a consistent visual design using TailwindCSS

features.name: Frontend UI Shell
features.description: Provides the main application layout and navigation for the Sellora frontend.
user_flows: GET / to load the main application shell -> Receive the Sellora UI homepage and navigation layout
GET / to load the application -> Receive 404 or error state when the frontend route is unavailable

features: Frontend UI for Sellora E-Commerce Intelligence
